function.name: record
function.description: Records all specified queries into their corresponding categories based on intent names provided as keyword arguments. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

faq_auto_withdraw_start.description: A list of queries about setting up or understanding automatic withdrawals, including benefits and signup instructions.

payment_information_start.description: A list of queries regarding balance checks, due dates for credit cards or other financial accounts.

pma_income_requirements_start.description: A list of queries concerning the income requirements for obtaining mortgages or loans.

outofscope.description: A list of queries that do not fit into any other specified intent categories.

1. "Can I use bonuses or commissions as part of my income for a loan application?" -> income requirements -> pma_income_requirements_start
2. "Can I schedule automatic withdrawals for different dates?" -> auto withdraw -> faq_auto_withdraw_start
3. "How much do I owe on my home equity loan?" -> balance check -> payment_information_start
4. "Will my income be verified during the loan application process?" -> income verification -> pma_income_requirements_start
5. "Is there a minimum income threshold for loan approval?" -> income threshold -> pma_income_requirements_start

Thus we produce JSON with lists accordingly.
